title: Exploring the Tunability and Dynamic Properties of MarR-PmarO Sensor System in Escherichia coli.
authors: Zou, Yusong; Li, Chenyi; Zhang, Ruihua; Jiang, Tian; Liu, Ning; Wang, Jian; Wang, Xianqiao; Yan, Yajun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大肠杆菌MarR-PmarO转录因子生物传感器的可调性，通过动态建模模拟MarR与marO盒的相互作用和结合能，并指导启动子突变以优化动态性能，属于TF-DNA互作建模的工程应用，但方法深度和机制聚焦有限。
abstract: Transcriptional factor-based biosensors (TFBs) have been widely used in dynamic pathway control or high-throughput screening. Here, we systematically explored the tunability of a salicylic acid responsive regulator MarR from Escherichia coli aiming to explore its engineering potential. The effect of endogenous MarR in E. coli on the MarR-PmarO biosensor system was investigated. Furthermore, to investigate the function of marO binding boxes in this biosensor system, a series of hybrid promoters were constructed by placing the marO binding boxes in the strong constitutive pL promoter. The engineered hybrid promoters became responsive to MarR and salicylic acid. To further study the influence of each nucleotide in the marO box on MarR binding, we employed dynamic modeling to simulate the interaction and binding energy between each nucleotide in the marO boxes with the corresponding residues on MarR. Guided by the results of the simulation, we introduced mutations to key positions on the hybrid promoters and investigated corresponding dynamic performance. Two promoter variants I12AII4T and I12AII14T that exhibited improved responsive strengths and shifted dynamic ranges were obtained, which can be beneficial for future metabolic engineering research.
abstract_zh: 基于转录因子的生物传感器（TFBs）已被广泛应用于动态通路控制或高通量筛选。在此，我们系统探索了大肠杆菌中水杨酸响应调控因子MarR的可调性，旨在挖掘其工程化潜力。研究了内源性MarR在大肠杆菌中对MarR-PmarO生物传感器系统的影响。此外，为探究marO结合盒在该生物传感器系统中的功能，通过将marO结合盒置于强组成型pL启动子中，构建了一系列杂合启动子。这些工程化杂合启动子对MarR和水杨酸产生了响应。为进一步研究marO盒中每个核苷酸对MarR结合的影响，我们采用动态建模模拟了marO盒中各核苷酸与MarR上相应残基之间的相互作用及结合能。在模拟结果的指导下，我们对杂合启动子的关键位点引入了突变，并考察了相应的动态性能。获得了两个启动子变体I12AII4T和I12AII14T，它们表现出增强的响应强度和改变的动态范围，这可能对未来代谢工程研究有益。
